what: A shop contract (contracts/src/ChogShop.sol) that sells items for one Chog Genesis token id, paid in $CHOG, tried against the real token and the real collection on a local copy of Monad mainnet. Nothing was deployed and no transaction was sent to the chain.
tool: Foundry forge 1.8.1, solc 0.8.28, evm version cancun, optimizer 800 runs (the settings of the Genesis contract). The copy of the chain needs the option --network monad.

chain_facts_read_today.chog_token: 0x350035555E10d9AfAF1566AaebfCeD5BA6C27777: name 'Chog', symbol 'CHOG', 18 decimals, totalSupply 1e27, DOMAIN_SEPARATOR 0x5e3d1e5b797c9a8020ac422be278ef7aebb2fe62a508c81ce14268b32deef11c (cast call on rpc.monad.xyz)
chain_facts_read_today.not_the_token: 0x7f64ccfeb3e3afd7691ea0ef404e947786cefae8 is the implementation behind the token (the address in the Sourcify link of the research report): it answers an empty name, a zero supply and a zero domain separator. It must not be used as the token.

unit_tests: 13 pass against stand-ins, one of them a fuzz test over price and burned share (256 runs).

fork_tests.setup: The shop deployed on the copy with a burned share of 50%; a test key given 1000 $CHOG on the copy with the test runner's 'deal'.
fork_tests.test_TheRealTokenAcceptsThePermitThePaym: pass: buyWithPermit for token 1795 with a permit signed over the token's on-chain domain separator; the buyer's balance drops by exactly 100, the treasury receives 50, the total supply drops by 50, the allowance is back to 0, the buyer's nonce is 1.
fork_tests.test_ATokenIdThatIsNotAGenesisIsRefusedB: pass: token id 1970 reverts, nothing is paid.

limits: A copy of the chain is not the chain: no real transaction, no real wallet, no gas paid. Monad charges gas on the limit; the limit to give a wallet was not measured.
The contract was not reviewed by anyone else and not audited.
What is sold, where the $CHOG goes and who deploys are not decided; the game does not read the contract.
